name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a factory tour as a young engineering student. He was captivated by the artistry and precision involved in the painting process, seeing it as a blend of technical skill and aesthetic expression. After graduating, he pursued an apprenticeship at a local auto body shop, honing his skills in color matching, paint application, and surface preparation. 

Wei's approach to his role is deeply rooted in practicality and efficiency. He believes in meticulous planning, clear communication, and a constant pursuit of improvement. He's known for his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve paint-related issues, often devising innovative solutions to challenging problems. His colleagues value his calm demeanor and his willingness to share his expertise. What sets Wei apart is his deep understanding of how different paints and coatings perform under extreme racing conditions, a knowledge he leverages to ensure both the durability and visual appeal of the team's vehicles.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with slight recession at the temples
physical.description: A man of medium build, Wei's face shows the wisdom and experience of years spent perfecting his craft.

quirks: Always meticulously cleans his paint guns immediately after use, regardless of how busy he is.
Insists on using traditional Chinese calligraphy brushes for fine detailing work.
Keeps a small notebook filled with paint color formulas and mixing ratios.
